description: This file defines the abstract class 'ChannelOwner' which manages communication channels, event subscriptions, and API call wrapping within the Playwright core library. It includes methods for subscription management, API call instrumentation, and object lifecycle handling.

classes.name: ChannelOwner
classes.description: An abstract class managing communication channels, event subscriptions, and API call instrumentation for Playwright objects.

methods.name: _setEventToSubscriptionMapping
methods.description: Sets the mapping between event names and subscription protocol events.

methods.name: _updateSubscription
methods.description: Updates the subscription status for a given event.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'on' to manage subscriptions when listeners are added.

methods.name: _adopt
methods.description: Adopts a child ChannelOwner, updating parent-child relationships.

methods.name: _dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the object, cleaning up references and disposing children.

methods.name: _debugScopeState
methods.description: Returns debug information about the object and its children.

methods.name: _validatorToWireContext
methods.description: Creates a ValidatorContext for API validation.

methods.name: _createChannel
methods.description: Creates a proxy channel object with validated methods.

methods.name: _wrapApiCall
methods.description: Wraps API calls with instrumentation, error handling, and stack trace collection.
